title: Zerblik Modpack
description: Vanilla Fantasy themed Modpack / This Modpack May be a hidden gem
body:
# ~~This is a modpack i made one night in under 2 hours while i was bored~~

I think this modpack should be something like vanilla/fantasy themed 

**This modpack should look good with and without shaders** 
_i'd still recommend playing it with shaders (the modpack comes with a good lightweight shader)_

### Things the modpack has:
- **ALOT** of structures (you have to travel a lot to find them tho) **Some structures have lore**
- More enchantments and enchants mechanics
- **Vanilla mobs variants, mobs levels, mobs with skills and improved movement** **(**Dont play this modpack in hard difficulty _You will get clapped_**)** ~~some mobs behave like player idk how~~
- _Armors and tools dont break for some reason_
- **Essentials** (in case you want to play with frens)
- More ingame friend interactions like (Handing over items, Feeding friends, Headpats)
- A lot of **decorative blocks**
- More villagers and villager mechanics
- A lot of new dimmensions with the **Stargate** mod
- More food and crops
**(**also farm mechanics like right clic to harvest and rain improvements for the crops soil**)**
- Texturepacks and shaders
- Ingame Texturepack/Shaders **&** worlds/maps **Downloader**
- Better combat and movements mechanics
- Back slot
- Crouch mechanic

### Things the modpack still doesn't have:
- Death waypoints
- Modded Bosses
- Auto updates
  
**I will list more things in the future**

## Technical things
- **You need to allocate the modpack with at least 6gb of ram** in the modpack config so it doesn run at 2 fps
- **Also the modpack needs java 25** (you can download it in the launcher settings)
